value.multiple-redirect-uris-and-token-refresh: GitHub OAuth apps now support multiple redirect URIs and improved token refresh, simplifying multi-environment deployments and reducing separate app registrations.
value.per-model-token-breakdown-in-the-usage-r: GitHub Copilot's usage report now details token consumption per AI model, enabling organizations to optimize usage costs and inform model enablement decisions.
value.visual-studio-code-1-134: Visual Studio Code 1.134 is released with new features and improvements, continuing the editor's rapid iteration cycle for developer productivity.
value.azure-copilot-introduces-direct-access-t: Azure Copilot now provides direct access to specialized AI agents, enabling users to invoke domain-specific agents from within Azure tooling for streamlined cloud management.
value.public-preview-azure-linux-on-wsl: Azure Linux is available in public preview for WSL, providing a Microsoft-supported Linux environment optimized for cloud workloads, reducing dev-prod parity issues.
value.visual-studio-code-1-133: Visual Studio Code 1.133 is released with new features and improvements, impacting millions of developers through its rapid iteration cycle.
value.public-preview-markdown-for-agents-in-az: Azure App Service offers public preview for Markdown rendering in agent-based applications, simplifying how AI agents serve formatted content and enabling richer structured outputs.
value.generally-available-dragon-copilot-physi: Dragon Copilot's physician-focused AI apps and agents are now generally available on Microsoft Marketplace, bringing AI-assisted clinical workflows to healthcare.
value.public-preview-sql-formatter-in-mssql-ex: The MSSQL extension for VS Code now includes a public preview SQL Formatter, automatically formatting T-SQL queries to consistent style guidelines.
value.microsoft-fabric-item-recovery-enabled-b: Microsoft Fabric's Item Recovery feature will be enabled by default for tenants, providing automatic protection against accidental deletion; review governance policies.
